<ul>
<li><strong>VAPOURISATION</strong> will now melt a random icewall if one is present when thrown at the ground. Note that this will only take place if one of its other effects do not - melting frozen ground and removing flood will always take priority. <em>(4/20/2017 · post #2)</em></li>
<li>You may now <strong>ADMINISTER NUTRITIONAL</strong> to other adventurers. <em>(7/10/2017 · post #6)</em></li>
<li>Highly <strong>VOLATILE PETRIFYING</strong> compounds now convey a version of the <strong>IRONFORM</strong> defence that expires after five minutes. Low volatility versions of the compound continue to convey a version of the defence that lasts indefinitely. <em>(7/10/2017 · post #6)</em></li>
<li>Fixed an issue with <strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> where successive kills could push you over the original maximum mayology duration. <em>(8/3/2017 · post #7)</em></li>
<li><strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> now has a 5 minute cooldown between uses. We may increase or decrease this depending after some monitoring of the situation. <em>(10/4/2017 · post #9)</em></li>
<li><strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> now periodically damages the user every five seconds with a message to the room indicating that the enhanced state is present. <em>(10/4/2017 · post #9)</em></li>
<li>The passive damage to the alchemist while under the influence of <strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> is now multiplied by the number of people with <strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> active in their room. <em>(3/26/2018 · post #23)</em></li>
<li><strong>INCENDIARY</strong> ticks will no longer trigger deliverance. <em>(4/20/2018 · post #24)</em></li>
<li><strong>CONCUSSIVE</strong> now diminishes in potency for each person it throws from a location. So each subsequent person has a less likely chance of being thrown, essentially. <em>(4/20/2018 · post #24)</em></li>
<li><strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> now extends your herb and elixir balance when it is active. <em>(4/20/2018 · post #24)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>CORROSIVE</strong> compound now has a much greater chance to fire if thrown in room. This is not necessarily 100% (as some compound alterations can influence this significantly), but in most cases it is now vastly superior. <em>(5/22/2018 · post #25)</em></li>
<li><strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> now only modifies the balance and equilibrium times for physiology and alchemy abilities. <em>(6/1/2018 · post #27)</em></li>
<li><strong>HOMUNCULI</strong> now explode upon both the activation of <strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> and the periodic ticks of damage that occur. <em>(1/21/2019 · post #33)</em></li>
<li><strong>MAYOLOGY</strong> now will credit the person who has the highest impact on the fight against the alchemist when they die... if they&#39;re alive. <em>(3/21/2023 · post #118)</em></li>
<li>You can no longer throw phials into indoors rooms while flying, you fiends. <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em></li>
<li><strong>CONCUSSIVE</strong> now derives several benefits depending on how you&#39;ve altered it using the <strong>ALTERATION</strong> ability. High <strong>POTENCY</strong> will cause the alchemist who threw it to have their mass always ignored when determining whether they should be thrown or not, but the other benefits are left as an exercise for the scientists among you to discover. <em>(3/15/2025 · post #142)</em></li>
<li>Nothing in formulation is dodgeable. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li>(bug) Fixed an issue with high <strong>POTENCY CONCUSSIVE FORMULA</strong>. <em>(12/31/2025 · post #167)</em></li>
</ul>

<li>The <strong>PARASITE</strong> affliction now extends the <strong>SPEED</strong> defence raising time by 2 seconds. <em>(4/16/2017 · post #1)</em></li>

<li>You may now change the <strong>ATTUNEMENT</strong> of a target&#39;s shadow by simply attempting to <strong>ATTUNE</strong> the new type. <li><strong>STRIKE</strong> now advances the attune timer by 3 seconds rather than 1. <em>(7/4/2021 · post #83)</em></li>
<li>Depthswalkers now inately see in the dark for... obvious reasons. <em>(10/11/2022 · post #108)</em></li>

Snb and dual blunt saw the smallest reduction, dual cutting and two handed saw the greatest. Blademaster retains old engage damage. <em>(1/17/2024 · post #125)</em></li>
<li>Nothing is dodgeable. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>

<details className="classlead-skill">

<strong>Oppression</strong> <span className="classlead-meta">33 changes</span>
</summary>
<ul>
<li><strong>OPPRESSION</strong> has replaced <strong>NECROMANCY</strong> for Infernals. <em>(8/22/2020 · post #56)</em></li>
<li>You can now have multiple hellforged weapons, but only one of each type. It is intended that you only use one at a time (so only get one effect per combo): this is just for more trivial switching between weapon types and specialisations. To facilitate this, only one oppression effect can fire per combo where dual wielding specs are concerned. <em>(8/27/2020 · post #57)</em></li>
<li>To facilitate this, we needed to rework some things, particularly around inline investing. The only change that you should see is that order matters now where it did not: if your hellforged weapon is in your left hand, the effect you want on it will need to go first. Functionally it follows the same rules as envenoming, where previously it technically did not. <em>(8/27/2020 · post #57)</em></li>
<li><strong>APOTHEOSIS</strong> has seen some small <strong>RP</strong> and mechanical additions where the champion is concerned. <em>(8/27/2020 · post #57)</em></li>
<li>Calling your weapon will now call all of your hellforged weapons to you. <em>(8/27/2020 · post #57)</em></li>
<li><strong>CONQUEROR</strong> now has a short cooldown on firing against players. <em>(9/3/2020 · post #58)</em></li>
<li><strong>QUASH</strong> now does a reduced amount of damage in the case where it strips a target&#39;s shield. <em>(2/18/2021 · post #65)</em></li>
<li>Subsequent <strong>AGONY</strong> checks on an <strong>ARC</strong> now have a diminishing chance to fire. This is on an <strong>ARC</strong> by <strong>ARC</strong> basis, it resets each <strong>ARC</strong>. <em>(2/18/2021 · post #65)</em></li>
<li>New ability: <strong>CRIPPLE</strong>. <em>(6/19/2021 · post #79)</em></li>
<li><strong>PUNISHMENT</strong> has had its scaling adjusted. Its the same as previously at two afflictions or lower, but adds more for each affliction after that point. <em>(6/19/2021 · post #79)</em></li>
<li>Healthleech being in place will now cause the affliction healing portion of agony to fire, though with a 10 second cooldown. This does not lock out the bleed requirement and does not stack with the bleed requirement, but should be more achieveable for certain specialisations. <em>(9/16/2021 · post #90)</em></li>
<li><strong>RELENTLESS</strong> now reduces your chance to be impacted by the <strong>STUPIDITY</strong> affliction. <em>(2/23/2022 · post #101)</em></li>
<li><strong>VIVISECT</strong> now bypasses <strong>STARBURST</strong>. <em>(6/13/2022 · post #105)</em></li>
<li><strong>BLOODLUST</strong> can now push you above maximum health and mana when it fires, up to a cap of 150% of your max. <em>(10/11/2022 · post #108)</em></li>
<li><strong>ANGUISH</strong> has been made better to reflect its placement in the skill. In addition to its previous functionality, it now also causes you to retain the majority of your defences (and hellforgings) upon starbursting or similar. <em>(2/7/2023 · post #114)</em></li>
<li>All mounts and other loyals are moved to the <strong>APOTHEOSIS</strong> challenge room upon a duel concluding in the special arena. <em>(3/6/2023 · post #117)</em></li>
<li>You may now maintain up to two hellforge bonuses on your armour at once. <em>(5/9/2023 · post #120)</em></li>
<li><strong>AGONY</strong> is now an always on effect on a hellforged weapon, you no longer need to give up other investments to use it. <em>(6/21/2023 · post #121)</em></li>
<li><strong>AGONY</strong> no longer fires if you have no afflictions, wasting the passive cure cooldown. <em>(6/21/2023 · post #121)</em></li>
<li><strong>AGONY</strong> via <strong>HEALTHLEECH</strong> is now a twelve second passive cure cooldown, up from ten. <em>(1/9/2024 · post #124)</em></li>
<li><strong>DEATHAURA</strong> damage has been reduced slightly. <em>(1/19/2024 · post #126)</em></li>
<li><strong>PREDATOR</strong> now supports the <strong>SPHINX</strong> artefact power. <em>(1/19/2024 · post #126)</em></li>
<li>Untargeted <strong>ARC</strong> now accepts inline hellforge weapon investments. <em>(3/29/2025 · post #147)</em></li>
<li>There is now a message when <strong>TORMENT</strong> gives healthleech. As a result, the message to the target receiving healthleech from this ability has changed. <em>(3/29/2025 · post #147)</em></li>
<li><strong>RAMPAGE</strong> now incurs a balance cost as the abfile falsely indicated it did. <em>(3/29/2025 · post #147)</em></li>
<li>The balance cost for <strong>RAMPAGE</strong> in the ability file has been reduced slightly. <em>(3/29/2025 · post #147)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>A comment here: my original intent for this skill was that it would serve as a leap style skill that would bypass rng hinders. Unfortunately the balance cost was never being incurred, so it was more serving as a straight instant bypass of walls/hinders. I considered adding a monolith check like hunt, but felt it wasn&#39;t appropriate given there are some key differentiations between the requirements for rampage and its closest analogue (Excision Hunt). Ultimately, I decided that my original intent is still the right direction for the ability and class as a whole and so have gone with this change.</li></ul></li>
<li>nothing is dodgeable. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li><strong>QUASH</strong> can now be used against denizens. This does strip magical shields against denizens. <em>(11/14/2025 · post #162)</em></li>

I will monitor and potentially cut <strong>CONFUSION</strong> as well, but I am inclined that this low rate passive focus may be useful as something you can offensively adapt off of, so am leaving it for now. <em>(12/31/2025 · post #167)</em></li>
<li>(52): <strong>AGONY</strong> reworked somewhat. The cooldown remains unchanged. <em>(8/4/2026 · post #171)</em></li>
<li>(Admin): <strong>AGONY</strong> abfile updated to accurately reflect the cooldown - its twelve seconds, not ten. <em>(8/4/2026 · post #171)</em></li>

<li>(46) <strong>RAGE</strong> has undergone a rework. Rather than continuing to chip away at what it can cure, we&#39;ve reworked this. The cooldown has been increased, and the idea is that rather than this functioning as a random cure ability on classes that already have a lot going for them in this regard, it will serve as a combo disrupter with a high skill ceiling. <li>You can now perform balloon related actions while selfish. More changes to come here for other cases, but they are much more involved. <em>(6/21/2021 · post #80)</em></li>
<li>There has been a major rewrite to juggling, so if you see anything odd, please let me know. <em>(7/4/2021 · post #83)</em></li>
<li>You may now <strong>THROW JUGGLED</strong>, or <strong>THROW JUGGLED</strong>&lt;#&gt; to throw a juggled item. If throwing without a number specified you will throw in the order you started juggling your items, if specifying a number you will specify that position in the list of items you started juggling. Examples: <em>(7/4/2021 · post #83)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li><strong>JUGGLE DAGGER123</strong> dagger124 dagger125 to start juggling these three items with very suspect item IDs.</li><li><strong>THROW JUGGLED AT MAKARIOS</strong> will throw dagger123 at makarios</li><li><strong>THROW JUGGLED AT MAKARIOS</strong> will throw dagger124 at makarios</li><li><strong>THROW JUGGLED AT MAKARIOS</strong> will throw dagger125 at makarios</li><li><strong>JUGGLE DAGGER123</strong> dagger124 dagger125 to start juggling again.</li><li><strong>THROW JUGGLED2 AT MAKARIOS</strong> will throw dagger124 at Makarios, as this was the second item in your list.</li><li><strong>THROW JUGGLED2 AT MAKARIOS</strong> would then throw dagger125 at Makarios, as this is the new second item in your list.</li></ul></li>
<li>Inlining envenoming works with the above (so <strong>THROW JUGGLED AT MAKARIOS CURARE</strong> for example). <em>(7/4/2021 · post #83)</em></li>
<li>In case for some reason this impacts you, quitting now unjuggles your items. <em>(7/4/2021 · post #83)</em></li>

<li>(Dual blunt): <strong>DOUBLEWHIRL</strong> and <strong>WHIRL</strong> now give a fracture to the relevant limb when hitting head, torso, or arms. <em>(2/17/2023 · post #115)</em></li>
<li>(Dual blunt): <strong>EXPEND</strong> has undergone major revisions. See the abfile for details. <em>(2/17/2023 · post #115)</em></li>
<li>(Dual blunt): <strong>ASSAULT TORSO</strong> has had its damage reduced. It now gives 3 cracked rib fractures. <em>(2/17/2023 · post #115)</em></li>

<li><strong>UNDERCUT</strong> will now always break the limb if striking it when above ninety percent damage. <em>(4/17/2023 · post #119)</em></li>
<li>(Two Handed): if you miss with a non speed enhanced strike, the recovery time will be faster. Note this does not apply to rebounding, only due to actual misses. <em>(9/20/2023 · post #122)</em></li>
<li>(Two handed): <strong>TORN TENDONS</strong> now fire below most other traditional room hinders, to prevent you nerfing your room hinder by accident as two h. <em>(1/9/2024 · post #124)</em></li>

<li>(Sword and Shield): <strong>DEDICATION</strong> now requires max ferocity and halves your ferocity upon use. The willpower cost has been removed. <em>(2/20/2024 · post #127)</em></li>
<li>(Dual Blunt): <strong>FUROR</strong> now does the relevant checks before the whirl combo, not after the attacks start landing. <em>(7/10/2024 · post #130)</em></li>
<li>(Dual Blunt): <strong>ASSAULT TORSO</strong> no longer breaks the torso. It now does two fractures against no torso break, three against mild internal trauma, and four against serious internal trauma. <em>(7/10/2024 · post #130)</em></li>
<li>(Sword and Shield): <strong>SMASH HIGH</strong> now gives the scrambled brains affliction instead of a focus knock. <em>(7/10/2024 · post #130)</em></li>
<li>(Sword and board): Broadsword slashes now do significantly more limb damage than their longsword counterparts. Health damage remains unchanged. <em>(7/15/2024 · post #131)</em></li>
<li>(Dual Cutting): <strong>RAZESLASH</strong> now has a negative speed modifier (so its slower, still scales with weapon speed but worse than other attacks). <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em></li>
<li>(Two Handed): <strong>OVERWHELM</strong>&#39;s window of opportunity has been made slightly longer. <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em></li>
<li>Untargeted <strong>ARC</strong> damage has been reduced slightly. I don&#39;t want to go full on take the eq+untargeted arc nuke away here as I think it still has a place, but it is overperforming currently compared to where I would like it to be. Something I&#39;ll be monitoring a bit more closely. <em>(3/23/2025 · post #144)</em></li>
<li>(Dual cutting): <strong>UNDERCUT</strong> can no longer miss if the target has <strong>NAUSEA</strong>. <em>(3/23/2025 · post #144)</em></li>
<li>(Sword and shield): New ability: <strong>ANTICIPATE</strong>. <em>(3/23/2025 · post #144)</em></li>
<li>(Sword and shield): New <strong>SHIELD STRIKE</strong>: <strong>DEFENCES</strong>. <em>(3/29/2025 · post #147)</em></li>
<li>(Relevant specs): <strong>DISEMBOWEL</strong> has under gone a formula rework. The first 15 str now count a little more towards the calculation, which means you affectively hit the insta threshold with torso a little sooner. Higher strength people should now find that they very rarely miss a disembowel kill with torso damage (if you&#39;re passed twenty, they&#39;re very dead now where this wasn&#39;t always the case). <em>(3/29/2025 · post #147)</em></li>
<li>(Sword and board): <strong>CLUB</strong> has had a very slight increase to the stun duration (you likely will not notice it). This was to fix an edge case where the stun could occasionally end a fraction too early and permit a writhe out of the impale where it was not intended to be possible. <em>(7/28/2025 · post #153)</em></li>
<li>(Two handed/dual blunt): members of these specs now perceive when fractures give afflictions in their room (note: when they afflict, not when they tick). <li>If noted, flat tohit means the abilities do not scale to weapon tohit. The default behaviour is they do. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>

<li><strong>LUNGE</strong> is now dodgeable. This tohit is flat. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li><strong>SLAUGHTER</strong> against denizens now deals <strong>BLUNT</strong> damage when wielding a warhammer rather than <strong>CUTTING</strong>. <em>(11/14/2025 · post #162)</em></li>
<li><strong>SLAUGHTER</strong> now deals bonus damage when under the effects of <strong>BATTLEFURY FOCUS PRECISION</strong>. <em>(11/14/2025 · post #162)</em></li>

<li><strong>WHIRL</strong> and <strong>DOUBLEWHIRL</strong> (DwB) have had their damage slightly increased against denizens. <em>(11/14/2025 · post #162)</em></li>
<li><strong>SLICE</strong> and <strong>SMASH</strong> (SnB) have had their damage slightly increased against denizens. <em>(11/14/2025 · post #162)</em></li>

<li>(260) (Dual blunt): <strong>ASSAULT TORSO</strong> does much less against an unbroken torso. <li>(255) (Dual cutting): <strong>MASTERY</strong> has had its armour bypassing potential cut from 20% to 15%. <em>(12/9/2025 · post #165)</em></li>
<li>(100): (Two handed): <strong>DISTRACT</strong> no longer interrupts channels that are set as unstoppable. Notably Aeonics Doom and Dragoncraft Devour in the relevant contexts. <em>(8/4/2026 · post #171)</em></li>

<li>(93): (Dual Blunt): <strong>EXPEND</strong> now gives a uniform relapse message to the attacker when an affliction relapses. The issue with asthma relapse showing a rogue paralysis message has also been resolved. <em>(10/23/2026 · post #178)</em></li>
<li>(157): (Two Handed): New ability: <strong>RETALIATE</strong>. <em>(10/23/2026 · post #178)</em></li>

<li>(46) <strong>RAGE</strong> has undergone a rework. Rather than continuing to chip away at what it can cure, we&#39;ve reworked this. It no longer has any restrictions upon what afflictions it can cure and retribution no longer blocks its use, but the affliction cured is now reapplied after around 3.5 seconds (when the rage &#39;fades&#39;). The cooldown has been increased, and the idea is that rather than this functioning as a random cure ability on classes that already have a lot going for them in this regard, it will serve as a combo disrupter with a high skill ceiling. Note that though this is not relevant currently, stacks will be preserved when the affliction is reapplied. <em>(12/9/2025 · post #165)</em></li>

<li><strong>DRUID PVE</strong> damage has been increased. <em>(10/4/2017 · post #9)</em></li>

<li><strong>SCRATCH</strong> now does more damage against denizens, and scales with strength. <em>(11/8/2017 · post #12)</em></li>

<li><strong>AMBUSH</strong> has been slightly sped up. <em>(4/20/2018 · post #24)</em></li>
<li>Morphs with the <strong>DIG</strong> power can now dig in digsites without a shovel. <em>(7/8/2018 · post #29)</em></li>

<li>Moved <strong>TRUMPET</strong> to <strong>BALANCE</strong> from <strong>EQUILIBRIUM</strong>. <em>(12/28/2018 · post #32)</em></li>
<li><strong>HYDRA BIND</strong> is now unique in that it costs both head balance and standard balance. This balance is relatively short to still permit bind to be used as a parry bypass tool, but it is my hope that this makes it less obnoxious to fight against (and less trivial to stack with other entangles). We will make further changes if this does not work out. <em>(12/28/2018 · post #32)</em></li>
<li>In light of sentinel&#39;s increased affliction pressure, <strong>PETRIFY</strong> now requires five afflictions instead of four. The list remains unchanged. <em>(10/4/2019 · post #49)</em></li>
<li><strong>PETRIFY</strong> no longer requires the afflictions to be given exclusively by the sentinel. <li><strong>VERTIGO</strong> now contributes towards the requirements for <strong>PETRIFY</strong>. <em>(2/18/2021 · post #65)</em></li>
<li><strong>TRUMPET</strong> no longer disrupts: disrupt has been replaced with sensitivity and now correctly only applies this if they&#39;re prone rather than on the prone as well. <em>(2/18/2021 · post #65)</em></li>
<li><strong>PARANOIA</strong> is no longer a petrify affliction. <em>(2/21/2021 · post #66)</em></li>

<li>Hypnosis all works inline. I.E: <em>(5/1/2025 · post #149)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li><strong>DSTAB MAKARIOS CURARE KALMIA IMPATIENCE</strong> to dstab curare+kalmia and suggest impatience.</li><li><strong>DSTAB MAKARIOS CURARE KALMIA SEAL</strong> 3 to dstab with curare + kalmia and seal a trance for 3 seconds.</li><li>Sub bite/flay for dstab as appropriate, it all works.</li></ul></li>
<li>The serpent is now informed when their hypnosis trance ticks a suggestion on a target, if they are in room. <em>(5/1/2025 · post #149)</em></li>

<li>New hypnosis ability: <strong>IMPULSE</strong>. This is an eq based ability that lets you fire a trivial suggestion on a target without a trance or similar. <em>(5/1/2025 · post #149)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>Note: this possesses illusion functionality, so you can impulse then bite off equilibrium.</li></ul></li>
<li><strong>IMPULSE</strong> supports inline bite. I.E: <strong>IMPULSE MAKARIOS MASOCHISM CURARE</strong> to impulse with masochism and bite with curare. <em>(5/1/2025 · post #149)</em></li>
<li>The ablist has undergone major revisions (mostly layout so its just easier to read and such). <em>(5/1/2025 · post #149)</em></li>
<li><strong>DISRUPT</strong> no longer fades after a time delay, it must be concentrated off. <em>(5/1/2025 · post #149)</em></li>
<li><strong>SEAL</strong> now has a minimum seal time of three seconds. Tickrate is unchanged. Unless the target has deadening at the time of sealing, in which case: <em>(5/1/2025 · post #149)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>Seal has a minimum time of one second and the tickrate drops to a fixed three seconds. Fixed in this case means the inate randomness to hypnosis tickrate is removed in this situation.</li></ul></li>
<li>There is now a cooldown (starting upon snap) before a new trance may be secured against a target. This cooldown starts at the beginning of the trance and not the end as to incentivise longer hypno chains and to mitigate the ability to keep someone in hypochondria hell. It is short and is not intended to be overly intrusive, so longer hypno chains will notice it very little if at all. <em>(6/18/2025 · post #152)</em></li>
<li><strong>LETHARGY</strong> has been swapped with nausea as a suggestion. <em>(7/31/2025 · post #154)</em></li>

<li>Nothing in Hypnosis is dodgeable. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li>(Admin): The <strong>DISRUPT</strong> suggestion now only truly disrupts if they are confused. Otherwise it imposes a short eq knock. <em>(6/5/2026 · post #170)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>Note: I mostly don&#39;t want this just being baked in as a powerful hinder into already strong hypno chains, but do want to keep the locking potential available since I feel its distinctly serpent. <li>(admin): <strong>SUGGEST</strong> while off balance now has a fixed, unmodifiable equilibrium. <em>(10/23/2026 · post #178)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>Notes: the attempt to slow down serpent early game while preserving the post snap explosiveness of the class continues. This one might very well get reverted though, we shall see how it pans out.</li></ul></li>
<li>(admin): <strong>SEAL</strong> is now unmodified equilibrium when off balance. <em>(10/23/2026 · post #178)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>See above.</li></ul></li>

<li>Nothing in Venom is dodgeable. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li><strong>NECHAMANDRA</strong> can now be used as an alternative to <strong>CAMUS</strong> or <strong>SUMAC</strong> against denizens. This venom deals <strong>COLD</strong> damage. <em>(12/8/2025 · post #164)</em></li>
<li>(12/33/admin): the <strong>CURARE</strong> ekanelia has been reworked. For a bit of exposition here, I feel we&#39;re very much overloading things in the hypno window with how current ekanelias worked so am endeavouring to move this away from the hypno chain. Consequently this does mean the ekanelia has more requirements, but they&#39;re relatively distinct from the traditional lock approach and should open up some non-hypno oriented forks without seriously overlapping with the already potent hypno based approaches. I generally envisioned this as a backup option and not a primary one, but its proved very good at weaving into offenses as a mainstay so I&#39;ll keep an eye on this change. <em>(8/18/2026 · post #173)</em></li>

<li>Loyal (alive) mobiles such as minipets, mounts, and artefact pets will no longer fall out of your inventory upon death/quitting/etc. <em>(4/16/2017 · post #1)</em></li>

Bypasses most forms of hiding, but does not bypass incorporeal status (blackwind, astralform, phase, and spiritwalk). This -does- bypass <strong>VEILED</strong> status. <em>(7/10/2017 · post #6)</em></li>
<li>You may no longer use atlatls in the arena. <em>(8/3/2017 · post #7)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>CLUMSINESS</strong> internal cooldown has been reduced from 5 seconds to 4.5. <em>(9/23/2017 · post #8)</em></li>

People who have these should contact me for either a free upgrade to a level 2 from level 1 or a 75% trade in of their additional gem. If you&#39;ve purchased an additional gem in the last six months, we&#39;ll offer a 100% tradein on said gem. <em>(10/4/2017 · post #9)</em></li>
<li>The cooldown on <strong>CLUMSINESS</strong> has been removed. <em>(10/4/2017 · post #9)</em></li>
<li><strong>LUCRESCENT NUTS</strong> now last for 2 hours instead of 1. <em>(10/4/2017 · post #9)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>STOP</strong> command can now be used while in aeon without resetting the sluggish timer. <em>(10/11/2017 · post #10)</em></li>
<li>All the various forms of <strong>FEAR</strong> now cancel tumble before the valid movement checks. So for instance if you rush about in fear but are paralysed/have broken legs/etc, the tumble will now be interrupted whereas previously it would not be. <em>(10/13/2017 · post #11)</em></li>
<li><strong>TRAMPLE</strong> via the <strong>ARACHNIDEYE</strong> talisman now only breaks two limbs all of the time if the target is prone. Otherwise it will always break one and have a chance to break 2. <em>(10/13/2017 · post #11)</em></li>
<li><strong>ASSESS</strong> with health inspector now has a 1 second cooldown, but can now be performed off balance/equilibrium. <em>(11/8/2017 · post #12)</em></li>
<li>Army leaders can now claim up to <strong>THREE</strong> bounties. Army members of the <strong>FOURTH</strong> rank or higher can now claim up to <strong>TWO</strong> bounties. Everyone else can still claim up to a maximum of <strong>ONE</strong> bounty. <em>(11/8/2017 · post #12)</em></li>
<li>You can now use syntax similar to <strong>GET</strong> &#91;<strong>SLITH</strong>&#93; in order to specifically get the corpse of Slith if possible. This should work for all commands that refer to corpses. <em>(11/13/2017 · post #13)</em></li>
<li>The issue where you could only throw <strong>CUBE SIGILS</strong> adjacent by <strong>ID</strong> has been resolved. You&#39;ll now only throw at ground if specifying <strong>AT GROUND</strong> or by not specifying a target as in <strong>THROW CUBE</strong>. <em>(11/13/2017 · post #13)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>NORTHEAST</strong> exit for <strong>ATAVIAN WINGS</strong> has been moved. <em>(11/13/2017 · post #13)</em></li>
<li>Charging organisational enemies with crimes is now logged to said organisations logs automatically. <em>(11/13/2017 · post #13)</em></li>
<li><strong>BALDRICS</strong> can now hold up to two weapons. <em>(12/5/2017 · post #14)</em></li>

<li>The periodic <strong>HYPOCHONDRIA</strong> ticks have had a slight reduction in frequency. <em>(12/5/2017 · post #14)</em></li>
<li><strong>LEGION LIST</strong> now outputs your squads in numeric order, sorted by their <strong>ID</strong>. <em>(12/28/2017 · post #16)</em></li>
<li>Cities may now request to purchase a furnishing workshop via <strong>PATRON REQUEST</strong>. <em>(12/28/2017 · post #16)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>CURSEWARD</strong> defence now drops on aggressive actions. <em>(12/28/2017 · post #16)</em></li>
<li>Several elemental lord attacks that bypassed reflections and didn&#39;t generate kai have been fixed. <em>(1/8/2018 · post #17)</em></li>
<li><strong>GEMS OF TRANSMUTATION</strong> now work when in Elemental form. <em>(2/2/2018 · post #18)</em></li>
<li><strong>COALESCE</strong> can now take you from your home Elemental Plane to outside the cave on Prime. This takes twice as long as going from Prime to Elemental. <em>(2/7/2018 · post #19)</em></li>

Those affected are: <strong>AEONICS DISTORTION</strong>, <strong>DEVOTION PIETY</strong>, <strong>NECROMANCY GRAVEHANDS</strong>, and <strong>SUBTERFUGE PINSHOT</strong>. <em>(4/20/2018 · post #24)</em></li>
<li>In light of the delay on speed being stripped, speeds time to come up as been halved to maintain the status quo for these mechanics. This does have some consequences, but they&#39;re positive ones. <em>(4/20/2018 · post #24)</em></li>
<li>Improved how serverside curing handles the speed defence. <em>(4/20/2018 · post #24)</em></li>
<li><strong>DIVE</strong> no longer acts as a bypass method for the <strong>TENSION</strong> affliction. <em>(4/20/2018 · post #24)</em></li>
<li><strong>SERVERSIDE CURING</strong> will now raise <strong>SELFISHNESS</strong> when prone. <em>(6/1/2018 · post #27)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>MIND WARDEN</strong> trait now functions the same as <strong>HEALTH INSPECTOR</strong>, in that it does not require balance/eq to use but has an internal cooldown. <em>(6/7/2018 · post #28)</em></li>
<li><strong>URN MOUNTS</strong> will always incur a balance when hitting room hinder, as with standard movement. <em>(6/7/2018 · post #28)</em></li>
<li>When PLUCKing feathers, you will now pull all at once. <em>(7/8/2018 · post #29)</em></li>
<li>Worn clothes that were already visible when carrying a shimmering orb can now be examined more closely. <em>(7/8/2018 · post #29)</em></li>
<li><strong>EVENTSTATUS</strong> now accepts an additional <strong>UNCOLOURED</strong> argument (e.g., <strong>ES DELOS UNCOLOURED</strong>). <em>(7/8/2018 · post #29)</em></li>
<li>The number of soldiers that must be present in a raid to prevent the timer ticking down twice as fast has been reduced from <strong>FIVE</strong> to <strong>TWO</strong>. <em>(1/31/2019 · post #34)</em></li>
<li>The critical hits generated via the <strong>MATIC</strong> legend card will no longer be modified by the crucious paragon (and as a result will not occasionally be dropped down to obliterating critical hits, they&#39;ll always be annihilating or higher). <em>(1/31/2019 · post #34)</em></li>
<li>Relaxed the command limitations on the underworld shroud talisman channel somewhat. <em>(2/3/2019 · post #35)</em></li>
<li>The underworld shroud talisman being active now has a chance to block your presence on <strong>FULLSENSE</strong>. <em>(2/3/2019 · post #35)</em></li>
<li>The delay on the <strong>SPEED</strong> defence coming up has been increased to 3 seconds, up from 2.5. <em>(6/10/2019 · post #43)</em></li>
<li>Magic travelblock effects (<strong>DURESS STORMFRONT</strong> and the <strong>PAZUZU</strong> legend card) now apply a five minute cooldown to the room. This applies to both, so if someone stormfronts you cannot immediately chain a pazuzu card when it ends. <em>(6/10/2019 · post #43)</em></li>
<li>Golden phials now have a tradein value (they&#39;ll trade in for 50 bound credits via <strong>PROMO TRADEIN</strong>). <em>(6/26/2019 · post #44)</em></li>
<li>All class-based illusion skills have had their default illusion length raised from 160 characters to 250. <em>(6/26/2019 · post #44)</em></li>
<li><strong>WORLDBURN</strong> will now require a shrine to be huge for it to effect in said shrine&#39;s influence. It can be started from any shrine still. <em>(6/26/2019 · post #44)</em></li>
<li><strong>GEMS OF CLOAKING</strong> now last for 20 minutes with a 2 hour cooldown rather than 10 minutes with a one hour cooldown, to permit more useful useage of the concealment window. <em>(7/28/2019 · post #45)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>PEACE</strong> affliction is now focusable. <em>(8/21/2019 · post #46)</em></li>
<li><strong>ATLATLS</strong> now require at least 5 rooms of distance between you and the target at the time of throwing. Once its in the air distance isn&#39;t a factor anymore. <em>(8/24/2019 · post #47)</em></li>
<li>Auction veil items now only work for the owner. <em>(8/24/2019 · post #47)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>YEARN</strong> dagger now decays in stasis containers/stockrooms. If you find a way to avoid the decay of these, please file a bug report. <em>(8/24/2019 · post #47)</em></li>
<li>ENTERing artefact tents now respects room hinder. <em>(9/25/2019 · post #48)</em></li>
<li><strong>WRAITH SHACKLES</strong> now have a shorter balance time to use. <em>(9/25/2019 · post #48)</em></li>
<li>Your per descriptor mastery is now displayed on the descriptors output. <em>(9/25/2019 · post #48)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>SILVERY TANK OF ENTICEMENT</strong> now respects balance/equilibrium. It can still pull prone individuals. <em>(9/25/2019 · post #48)</em></li>
<li>You can now <strong>DISASSEMBLE</strong> other people&#39;s tents. There is a ten second interruptable channel for doing this if the tent does not belong to you. <em>(10/4/2019 · post #49)</em></li>
<li>You can now <strong>DISASSEMBLE</strong> tents with people in them. The people are kicked out into the outer room on this happening. <em>(10/4/2019 · post #49)</em></li>
<li>You can now <strong>DISASSEMBLE</strong> tents with non takeable items in them. If you find some special untakeable items that let you persist a tent, please let me know. Takeable items still prevent tent disassembling. I do acknowledge this allows people to persist tents by dropping something in them during combat, but I feel letting people disassemble tents with takeable items in them creates too many potential issues. <em>(10/4/2019 · post #49)</em></li>
<li>You can no longer <strong>IMPLANT</strong> totems in tents. <em>(10/4/2019 · post #49)</em></li>
<li>You can no longer raise shrines in tents. <em>(10/4/2019 · post #49)</em></li>
<li>Most non weapon-based classes have had their <strong>PVE</strong> damage increased. In some cases this is fairly significant, in others it is relatively minor. <em>(10/13/2019 · post #50)</em></li>
<li>Sylvans and priests have had their <strong>PVE</strong> damage increased across the board. <em>(10/31/2019 · post #51)</em></li>
<li>Runewardens no longer do more <strong>PVE</strong> damage than paladins and infernals (infernals and paladins have been brought up, runewarden has not gone down). <em>(10/31/2019 · post #51)</em></li>
<li>The sword and shield and two handed knight specialisations have had their damage increased in <strong>PVE</strong>. <em>(10/31/2019 · post #51)</em></li>
<li><strong>YEARN</strong> daggers now knock a month of their decay time off each time they&#39;re used to sense a victim. These were intended to be much more transient than the relic equivalent. <em>(12/2/2019 · post #53)</em></li>
<li>You can now form a bubble via the frogskin talisman in a watery location that isn&#39;t underwater, though this method has a five minute cooldown (this cooldown does not prevent forming underwater as is currently possible). <em>(12/2/2019 · post #53)</em></li>
<li>The firetank talisman <strong>WREATHE</strong> ability has had its cost decreased by a third. <em>(6/7/2020 · post #54)</em></li>
<li>Elemental Lords can now <strong>PARRY</strong> without a weapon. <em>(6/7/2020 · post #54)</em></li>
<li>You can no longer use <strong>WANDS OF REFLECTION</strong> if you are prone with a broken leg. Having either of these conditions in exclusion remains as before. <em>(7/19/2020 · post #55)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>AMA</strong>-<strong>MAALIER</strong> legend card no longer prevents elevation changes. <em>(7/19/2020 · post #55)</em></li>
<li>Dormant people are now omitted from bounty listings by default. You can view them by appending <strong>ALL</strong> to the end of the list command. <em>(7/19/2020 · post #55)</em></li>
<li>Drawing <strong>LEGEND CARDS</strong> will now unphase you before the effect activates. <em>(7/19/2020 · post #55)</em></li>
<li>Entourages (both player and otherwise) will no longer belost upon <strong>ENTERING</strong> sewer grates. <em>(7/19/2020 · post #55)</em></li>
<li>Critical hit carryover from the <strong>MAYA FIGURINE</strong> talisman has had its window of opportunity increased by 3 seconds. <em>(8/22/2020 · post #56)</em></li>
<li>The FASTER_INSCRIBING artefact power now increases the maximum number of tarot cards you can inscribe in a batch by 20. <em>(8/22/2020 · post #56)</em></li>
<li>Urn mounts now have the same health as pathfinders, and calling them incurs the balance along with initial creation (though slightly less). <em>(8/22/2020 · post #56)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>ORB OF CONFINEMENT</strong> improvement no longer blocks flight and duanathar 100% of the time: it now functions as a standard room hinder effect where these too actions are concerned. It functions as before in the case where you are attempting to fly in and out of the city proper. <em>(8/22/2020 · post #56)</em></li>
<li>Blademasters can now wear <strong>SCALEMAIL</strong> up from <strong>RINGMAIL</strong>. <em>(8/22/2020 · post #56)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>GILDED BIT</strong> talisman effect now has a 20 minute cooldown and cannot be activated from a city that is not your own. It can be used from outside city limits as previously in all cases. <em>(8/22/2020 · post #56)</em></li>
<li>The aggression cooldown has been lowered to 8 minutes from 10. We may reevaluate this, but I think this is a reasonable reduction with still leaving class switching as nontrivial mid conflict (which is by design). <em>(9/3/2020 · post #58)</em></li>
<li>You can now utilise <strong>DASH</strong> and similar skills while massed so long as you are wearing a shackle artefact (or themed equivalent). <em>(9/25/2020 · post #59)</em></li>
<li>When you <strong>RUB</strong> urn artefacts, if your mount has been slain it shall now tell you how long until you can summon a new one. <em>(9/30/2020 · post #60)</em></li>
<li>Daggers, both standard and artefact versions, have been made faster. <em>(9/30/2020 · post #60)</em></li>
<li>If a shrine loses <strong>CONSECRATION</strong> due to <strong>WORLDBURN</strong> being activated, re-consecrating it in the window afterwards no longer conveys protection from <strong>DESECRATION</strong>. If said shrine was already <strong>DESECRATED</strong> before the worldburn is activated, <strong>CONSECRATION</strong> works as before. I&#39;ll keep an eye on this to see if more changes are needed. <em>(12/4/2020 · post #62)</em></li>
<li>The level 2 <strong>ILLUSIONS</strong> artefact power (the one conveyed via the <strong>LIGHTSPIRE</strong> artefact) now gives a bonus to the illusion detecting aspect of <strong>LIFEVISION</strong>. This does require you have the lifevision defence. <em>(12/4/2020 · post #62)</em></li>
<li><strong>TSOL</strong>&#39;<strong>AA</strong> now recover faster from <strong>SWING UP</strong>/<strong>DOWN</strong> in forests. <em>(12/30/2020 · post #64)</em></li>
<li><strong>DIZZY</strong> has had its success rate raised from 20% to 25%. <em>(2/18/2021 · post #65)</em></li>
<li><strong>STUPIDITY SECRETS</strong> will no longer be a valid stupidity reaction while paralysed. <em>(4/3/2021 · post #70)</em></li>
<li><strong>FIRELASH</strong> now functions as a counter to thornwalls. It takes three firelashes to drop a wall within a one minute span: these do not need to be from the same person, though do need to be from the same side of the wall. <em>(4/19/2021 · post #72)</em></li>
<li>The amount of limb damage dealt is now indicated to the attacker. This does not apply for limb damage dealt at a non local scope as of this time (i.e. LoS limb damage is not indicated). <em>(5/1/2021 · post #75)</em></li>
<li><strong>MASOCHISM</strong> ticks are now treated as a hostile action where <strong>REFLECTIONS</strong> are concerned. I.e. a masochism tick will clear your reflections. <em>(5/1/2021 · post #75)</em></li>
<li><strong>HUSKMAKER</strong> has had its stats adjusted to be in line with a level three artefact spear. <em>(5/25/2021 · post #76)</em></li>
<li><strong>HUSKMAKER</strong> now actually respects having a spear proficiency, so should no longer make you question where it all went so wrong whenever you try to use it as a weapon. <em>(5/25/2021 · post #76)</em></li>
<li>Checks that modify how various abilities function if a necromancer is in the room no longer accept blackwinded necromancers as valid. <em>(5/25/2021 · post #76)</em></li>
<li>Moving constable guards will now charge active tanks during a sanctioned raid. The first five guards to a lesser extent than ones passed that point. Note: this includes hiring, and is determined on initiation rather than success. Failure to move guards -does- count. <em>(5/25/2021 · post #78)</em></li>
<li>Some abilities were still working under old range constraints, having the 3 room limitation rather than 5. These have now been corrected: they include sublimation <strong>ERUPTION</strong>, runelore <strong>THURISAZ</strong>, tarot <strong>STAR</strong> and <strong>METEOR ARROWS</strong>. <em>(6/21/2021 · post #80)</em></li>
<li>New curing option: <strong>CURING FOCUS WITH</strong>/<strong>WITHOUTGUILT</strong>. Does basically what it says, if you set it to withguilt you&#39;ll focus while you have guilt (if you really want to for some reason) but most people will want to set it to withoutguilt and thereby serverside will not focus while you have the guilt affliction, avoiding ping dependent focus toggles clientside. <em>(6/21/2021 · post #80)</em></li>
<li>Strongholds now have a cap of 100 troops per room. <em>(6/30/2021 · post #81)</em></li>
<li>Stronghold troop capacity has been reduced from 480 to 400. <em>(6/30/2021 · post #81)</em></li>
<li>Note these stronghold changes are not retroactive to avoid major disruption, but should self correct pretty rapidly. <em>(6/30/2021 · post #81)</em></li>
<li>You can no longer witness shrines in cities or order territory you are enemied to. Functionally these are bounties for being the aggressor, which was never their intent. <em>(6/30/2021 · post #81)</em></li>
<li><strong>SKETCH</strong> via the tome of muses now incurs a 90 second cooldown. <em>(6/30/2021 · post #81)</em></li>
<li><strong>EARRINGS OF SINOPE</strong> now operate under different rules based on if the initiator and target are in the same local area. <em>(7/2/2021 · post #82)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>Same area is unchanged.</li><li>Different area now has a longer windup/equilibrium cost, and is prevented by a monolith on either end.</li></ul></li>
<li>People&#39;s current class is now visible on <strong>HONOURS</strong>. <em>(7/2/2021 · post #82)</em></li>
<li><strong>WALKTO</strong> will now utilise <strong>GLIDE</strong> when in <strong>DRAGONFORM</strong>. <em>(7/4/2021 · post #83)</em></li>
<li>Having either the <strong>CHARGESHIELD</strong> or <strong>CIRCULATE</strong> defence will cause the confusion eq penalty to be reduced from 50% to 30%. <em>(7/12/2021 · post #84)</em></li>
<li>Added <strong>FORAGER DISMISS</strong>. Note: you may not dismiss foragers out on deployment. <em>(7/12/2021 · post #84)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>BELL TATTOO</strong> defence now warns you when a phased serpent places a whisperstone in your location, though it does not tell you who did it. Unphased does not warn you, as there is already a message for when this occurs. <em>(7/12/2021 · post #84)</em></li>
<li><strong>PREVAIL</strong> is now more like <strong>DRAGONFORM</strong> in terms of what it preserves: vibes, chaos entities, etc. If you discover anything that now preserves that clearly shouldn&#39;t or find a way to gain access to these preserved lesserform defences/resources/etc, let me know <strong>ASAP</strong>. <em>(7/12/2021 · post #84)</em></li>
<li>The lognote to cities when someone claims a bounty no longer indicates who claimed it. <em>(7/12/2021 · post #84)</em></li>
<li>The more specific information concerning bounties is now appended to the military log instead, so designated individuals still can quickly refer to it. <em>(7/12/2021 · post #84)</em></li>
<li>Since you could already do it with gmcp, you can now check abfiles for abilities in skills you don&#39;t know. You must be specific in this case (specify both skill and ability) rather than just specifying ability as you may with skills you know. <em>(7/16/2021 · post #85)</em></li>
<li>When a leader of a group lands, you will now see their entourage. You no longer need wonder where the other 12 came from. <em>(7/16/2021 · post #85)</em></li>
<li>New <strong>CONFIG</strong> option: <strong>ALLOWENEMYFOLLOW</strong>. This grants the situationally unwise ability to follow people into enemy territory who are not in fact enemied. You are responsible for your own deaths when turning this config on and there will be no experience refunds when the predictable occurs. <em>(7/16/2021 · post #85)</em></li>
<li>If you notice anything odd with movement after these changes, let me know - we had to move some things around. <em>(7/16/2021 · post #85)</em></li>
<li>You may no longer write in journals/letters/etc while either on a dangerous plane (Underworld, Annwyn, etc) or while being radianced. Not that anyone would do that. <em>(7/31/2021 · post #86)</em></li>
<li><strong>LETHARGY</strong> has been reworked. It now disables the <strong>NIMBLE</strong> and <strong>QUICK WITTED</strong> traits instead of its former flat penalty to balance. <em>(8/20/2021 · post #87)</em></li>
<li>New command for practice arena duels: <strong>PREPME</strong>. This preps all your limbs to be one hit from breaking. We suggest you do not work under the assumption this will happen in a real duel. Note that this does not apply the limb reset timer, just for ease of use. <em>(8/23/2021 · post #88)</em></li>
<li><strong>SELARNIA</strong> now always cures below ablaze. <em>(10/3/2021 · post #91)</em></li>
<li>You can now prioritise by affliction stack. For example:<br /><strong>CURING PRIORITY ABLAZE5</strong> 1<br /><strong>CURING PRIORITY ABLAZE2</strong> 10<br /><strong>CURING PRIORITY ABLAZE1</strong> 26<br />Would set you to cure ablaze with 5 stacks at priority 1, 2 stacks at priority 10, and ignore ablaze at 1 stack entirely. <em>(10/3/2021 · post #91)</em></li>
<li>Random cure abilities (tree, passives, actives etc) will now try to cure a humour similar to eating a ginger if no other afflictions are present to be cured by said method. <em>(1/3/2022 · post #94)</em></li>
<li>Changing race will now recalculate your taken limb damage. So if you have 40% damage to your left leg, then change into an elemental lord, your left leg will recalculate to be 40% of your new max health&#39;s value. <em>(1/3/2022 · post #95)</em></li>
<li>The limb damage dealt line is now to two decimal places rather than one. <em>(1/3/2022 · post #95)</em></li>
<li><strong>WAND OF REFLECTION</strong> now tracks its cooldown on the caster and is one hour in duration. <em>(1/14/2022 · post #96)</em></li>
<li><strong>SWINGING UP</strong> has had its balance slightly increased. <em>(1/14/2022 · post #96)</em></li>
<li>Sipping <strong>IMMUNITY</strong> now hits you with loki if you sip it when you do not have the voyria affliction. <em>(2/23/2022 · post #101)</em></li>
<li><strong>MASOCHISM</strong> ticks now drop prismatic barriers. <em>(5/17/2022 · post #103)</em></li>
<li>The corpses of <strong>URN MOUNTS</strong> now must be in a player&#39;s inventory, or they will be destroyed. <em>(6/13/2022 · post #105)</em></li>
<li><strong>LACERATED THROAT</strong> can no longer be cured through non-salve methods (tree, passives, etc). <em>(6/13/2022 · post #105)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>URN</strong> corpse wipe checks now account for corpses held by people who are in the composer (these weren&#39;t wiping previously, this now counts as offline). <em>(7/25/2022 · post #107)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>TENDERSKIN</strong> now does some health damage when applying salves and not under the <strong>INQUISITION</strong> affliction. <em>(10/11/2022 · post #108)</em></li>
<li>Yank style attacks (boomerangs etc) now have a list of things that block them conditionally. Impale blocks them 100% of the time, pinshot blocks them 33% of the time, transfixation blocks them 33% of the time. I&#39;ll be monitoring these and adjusting as appropriate. <em>(10/30/2022 · post #109)</em></li>
<li><strong>SOULFIRE CRUCIBLES</strong> no longer randomly double their damage under certain conditions. <em>(2/17/2023 · post #115)</em></li>
<li><strong>CLUMSINESS</strong> is slightly more impactful against weapon&#39;s tohit stat now. <em>(2/19/2023 · post #116)</em></li>
<li>Elemental lords now dormant certain effects properly, the same as dragons (Crystalism vibes/Domination entities primarily). <em>(2/19/2023 · post #116)</em></li>
<li><strong>AUTOCURING</strong> now sends a stand immediately if possible when someone withdraws a blade which is impaling you. <em>(3/6/2023 · post #117)</em></li>
<li>When you lose a <strong>PRISMATIC BARRIER</strong>, there is now a 3 second timer before you may reraise one. This applies to all forms of barriers. <em>(3/6/2023 · post #117)</em></li>
<li><strong>TANK TENDING</strong> now shows up on the city logs like imbuing already did. <em>(3/6/2023 · post #117)</em></li>
<li><strong>UNBLOCKABLE</strong> damage now bypasses resist alls. Particularly relevant for finishers such as disembowel or freeze pound, but there are some other cases as well. This is a fairly major change, so let me know if anything seems odd. In particular this is a fairly nontrivial buff to soulspears, but we&#39;ll let that play out to see how it looks. <em>(4/17/2023 · post #119)</em></li>
<li>Added <strong>ENEMY PARTY</strong>. <em>(5/9/2023 · post #120)</em></li>
<li>There is now a message when the Maya figurine talisman stores critical hit damage. <em>(5/9/2023 · post #120)</em></li>
<li>The owner of a soulfire crucible must now be in its room or adjacent for it to fire. <em>(6/21/2023 · post #121)</em></li>
<li>When you die (burst and similar included), all active <strong>ENGAGES</strong> upon you are now cleared. <em>(9/20/2023 · post #122)</em></li>
<li>When <strong>WORLDBURN</strong> is activated, the <strong>TROINTETH</strong> cooldown on all shrines for that order is cleared. <em>(9/20/2023 · post #122)</em></li>
<li>Artefacts now reset out of linked containers. <em>(11/15/2023 · post #123)</em></li>
<li>Solo kills from a person with deathmask/guise enabled will now be hidden on assists from the obsidian hound carving talismans. This does not apply to multiple person kills. <em>(11/15/2023 · post #123)</em></li>
<li>When an invincible pets health reaches zero from being attacked it will stop attacking if its owner is not in the room (until commanded to attack again or attacked again). <em>(11/15/2023 · post #123)</em></li>
<li>Multiple item wield syntax (for example, <strong>WIWELD SCIMITAR SCIMITAR</strong>) now can accept the <strong>NOTHING</strong> keyword to ensure one of the hands remains empty. For example <strong>WIELD RITUALKNIFE NOTHING</strong> would make sure your ritual knife was in your left hand and the right remained free. <em>(11/15/2023 · post #123)</em></li>
<li>The RAPID_RESONATION artefact power no longer applies to the <strong>RETARDATION</strong> vibration. <em>(11/15/2023 · post #123)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>SCHEMATICS</strong> artefact power has been changed to the SORCEROUS_INSIGHT artefact power. <em>(11/15/2023 · post #123)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>YUDHISHTHIRA</strong> card has had its balance cost raised from 1.2 seconds to 2.0 seconds. <em>(1/9/2024 · post #124)</em></li>
<li><strong>SCALDED</strong> is now a timed cure, no more epidermal juggling. <em>(1/9/2024 · post #124)</em></li>
<li>Level two head breaks now give <strong>STUTTERING</strong> and <strong>CLUMSINESS</strong> in place of <strong>CONCUSSION</strong>. Messages have changed here too, for the one or two of you that actually care about that line. <em>(1/9/2024 · post #124)</em></li>
<li>There is now a line present on look and similar (the same as beacons and liberations) when a sanctioned raid is taking place in the current city. <em>(1/17/2024 · post #125)</em></li>
<li>Entering sewer grates now respects room hinder. Its also impossible if the room in question is destroyed (from tanks or similar). <em>(1/17/2024 · post #125)</em></li>
<li>You can no longer dodge weapons and similar while aeoned. <em>(1/17/2024 · post #125)</em></li>
<li>You can no longer <strong>SANCTION LIBERATIONS</strong> while beacon fortified. You can still fortify after a liberation starts, though that is liable to change after some monitoring. <em>(1/17/2024 · post #125)</em></li>
<li>Some oddities with afflictions not unmasking to serverside when symptoms have been detected on fly attempts have been resolved. <em>(1/19/2024 · post #126)</em></li>
<li>Grace is now stripped on a delay when moving through conquest areas. If you enter an area, the delay is ten seconds. If you are already in the area when graced (for instance, you rezzed via the cave or such) you will have thirty seconds after your first move before your grace is stripped. The cave and inside Yggdrasil are exempt from this, and moving to or from these rooms will not begin the countdown. As a result, you can no longer raise beacons or place tanks in either of these rooms or directly adjacent to said rooms. <em>(1/19/2024 · post #126)</em></li>
<li>Endurance and willpower no longer heal to full upon resurrection. See announce 5559 for a thorough explanation for this change. <em>(1/19/2024 · post #126)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>SCRAMBLED BRAINS</strong> affliction has been given additional functionality. <strong>AFFLICTION SHOW SCRAMBLEDBRAINS</strong> for details, but essentially it delays the affliction cure of focus mind to shortly before you&#39;d regain focus balance. This does scale with focus balance extenders or similar, and affects that fire off of focus are also delayed (for example, guilt will afflict when the affliction is cured, not when the focus takes place). <em>(7/10/2024 · post #130)</em></li>
<li><strong>LIMB HEALTH IS NOW</strong> A <strong>FIXED VALUE FOR ALL PLAYERS</strong>, <strong>IT NO LONGER SCALES OFF OF MAX HEALTH</strong>. See announce <em>(7/15/2024 · post #131)</em></li>
<li><strong>KAIDO TRANSMUTE</strong> has been integrated into serverside under the <strong>CURING KAIDOTRANSMUTE</strong> command. Let me know if you encounter any oddities, this was a little fiddly and there are several edge cases. Note that currently you simply will not transmute if you know you have recklessness, because the chance that it will just kill you almost certainly outweighs the chance it won&#39;t. Transmute will be checked before your queues fire, so you should no longer have to handle all of that clientside. <em>(12/30/2024 · post #135)</em></li>
<li>Fixed an issue with serverside which meant <strong>OPPRESSION BLOODLUST</strong> sometimes was being treat as masked recklessness, which would cause you to cure suboptimally under it. <em>(12/30/2024 · post #135)</em></li>
<li>Added <strong>CURING KAIDOTRANSMUTE MINIMUM</strong> &lt;amount&gt; by request - this basically is a way to tell the system not to transmute less than a certain value. So if you set it to 50 you&#39;ll never transmute under 50, to avoid constantly transmuting tiny amounts. <em>(1/2/2025 · post #136)</em></li>
<li>I had to change some things with the arena command, as certain actions were not correctly being gated. If you encounter not being able to do things you could previously (and that you should have been able to do...), let me know. <em>(1/2/2025 · post #136)</em></li>
<li>Personal landmark allowances (both default and purchaseable) have been increased. <em>(1/11/2025 · post #137)</em></li>
<li>The matic legend card effect no longer fires upon battlerage damage over time attacks, to avoid wasting it by mistake. <em>(1/11/2025 · post #137)</em></li>
<li>You now see when (and how much) limb damage you have taken, if it is not hidden in some manner (i.e. blackout for example). <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em></li>
<li>Denizen shields now have a line when they drop through various hidden means. <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em></li>
<li>Nausea passive damage reduced pretty significantly. This actually received a stealth buff (not by design) when the unblockable damage changes went in, so the overcorrection here was a little more significant than I anticipated. I&#39;ve increased the tick rate slightly (ten seconds to nine), but overall dps is down somewhat and burst is down significantly. Nutrition damage is unchanged for now, but I&#39;ll keep an eye on it. <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em></li>
<li>Applying salves while afflicted with slickness now doesn&#39;t show a 3p message. <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em></li>
<li>Removing <strong>TANKS</strong> via <strong>DISARM</strong> or <strong>CAPTURE</strong> mechanics now respect more safe commands during their mandatory channel actions. <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em></li>
<li>Passive curing messaging has been rewritten, so please let me know if you see anything odd as a result. As a consequence, there is now a message when generosity cures someone of an affliction: <em>(3/6/2025 · post #139)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>When generosity cures someone of something, they see a special 1p message and everyone else sees the 3p message of the passive curing source (so no new 3p lines), but you&#39;ll know it was generosity that cured you).</li><li>If it only has a 1p (we don&#39;t have many of these left, but there are some), you only get a 1p when generosity cures you - the room sees nothing.</li><li>There is now a 2p message to the person afflicted with generosity when that generosity causes them to passively heal someone else.</li><li>All generosity lines are only shown if a heal actually takes place. To minimise spam, if generosity blocks your passive cure but does not heal anyone, no lines are shown.</li></ul></li>
<li>Some new artefacts from reports (see announce #5664). <em>(3/14/2025 · post #141)</em></li>
<li><strong>FROZEN</strong> now longer extends the balance cost of tumble-style abilities. We can extend this to other things now if needed. <em>(3/15/2025 · post #142)</em></li>
<li>Removing a <strong>SHACKLE ARTEFACT</strong> under aggression cooldown will now set your density defence to expire in three seconds (we might tune this value a little more seeing how this pans out, but three is a good place to start is my feeling). Removing while not under aggression strips density immediately as previously. <em>(3/15/2025 · post #142)</em></li>
<li>Various major forest areas are now more likely to roll the <strong>FLUX</strong> conquest condition. <em>(3/20/2025 · post #143)</em></li>
<li><strong>LEAP</strong> style skills (including <strong>MOUNTJUMP</strong>) are no longer sped up by the nimble trait or other racial benefits. <em>(3/20/2025 · post #143)</em></li>
<li>You may now <strong>RELAX LIFEVISION</strong>. <em>(3/23/2025 · post #144)</em></li>
<li>Increased the rest bonus from sundered pennon somewhat (around a thirty percent increase). <em>(3/23/2025 · post #144)</em></li>
<li>Cut the cooldown on sundered pennon from four hours to two. <em>(3/23/2025 · post #144)</em></li>
<li><strong>ATLATL</strong> damage reduced a bit (its still a lot, but not... quite as much). <em>(3/23/2025 · post #144)</em></li>
<li><strong>ATLATL</strong> costs increased (level one to level two on all pieces). <em>(3/23/2025 · post #144)</em></li>
<li>You may now <strong>PREVAIL</strong> while mounted, and it will auto dismount you on the transformation completing. <em>(3/29/2025 · post #147)</em></li>
<li>Stupidity no longer functions under aeon effects. <em>(4/2/2025 · post #148)</em></li>
<li><strong>STUN</strong> now blocks the command initiation under aeon style effects, not the command resolution. <em>(4/2/2025 · post #148)</em></li>
<li><strong>AMNESIA</strong> now blocks the command initiation under aeon style effects, not the command resolution. <em>(4/2/2025 · post #148)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>Note: I&#39;m generally fine with aeon style effects across the board, but I want commands to matter here. Losing to commands failing when the command is so heavily gated feels bad so that is something we will be moving away from.</li></ul></li>
<li><strong>GENEROSITY</strong> now blocks the ability to order mobs to give you things. <em>(6/6/2025 · post #151)</em></li>
<li><strong>SCYTHERUS</strong> and <strong>FRATRICIDE</strong> now must be present at the time of relapse in all cases for the relapse to occur. <em>(6/18/2025 · post #152)</em></li>
<li><strong>LETHARGY</strong> has been removed from the <strong>HYPOCHONDRIA</strong> list. The entire duration of the aff&#39;s tick cycle remains unchanged (so impatience comes in at the same time as previously). <em>(7/28/2025 · post #153)</em></li>
<li><strong>HYPOCHONDRIA</strong>&#39;s order is now nausea, lethargy, impatience. <em>(7/31/2025 · post #154)</em></li>
<li>... artefact leadropes no longer make hostile occultist entities stick with you when you leap or similar. Sometimes, artefacts are apparently not the answer. <em>(8/12/2025 · post #155)</em></li>
<li>Fire and ice afflictions no longer cure one another. I believe I have got all of the instances of this happening, but if you come across one which has been missed, please do message me. <em>(8/30/2025 · post #156)</em></li>
<li><strong>HYPOCHONDRIA</strong> becomes a lobelia cure. <em>(9/15/2025 · post #158)</em></li>
<li>General note: weariness is no longer going to serve as a clumsiness hinder for some classes. This is being unified and clumsiness will fill this role universally. <em>(9/15/2025 · post #158)</em></li>
<li>Fixed some issues with frostbite not functioning in some contexts. <em>(10/6/2025 · post #159)</em></li>
<li>Being afflicted with <strong>AEON</strong> no longer makes you immune to dodging. This was previously introduced to make the jester aeonlock more reliable, and this is no longer necessary with the dexterity update. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li>All clumsiness involving weapons has been moved to a standard roll system. Previously this was a modifier on tohit into dex, which could result in either clumsiness being utterly crippling or utterly inaffective. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li><strong>WEARINESS</strong> no longer reduces the value of dex in the new dodge calculations - this was a patch fix that is no longer needed. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>GUISE</strong> talisman has had its damage type changed from unblockable to psychic. <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>GUISE</strong> talisman proc is now dodgeable(<strong>AOE</strong>). <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>CRUCIBLE</strong> talisman proc is now dodgeable (<strong>AOE</strong>). <em>(11/7/2025 · post #161)</em></li>
<li>The <strong>KILL</strong> command now prioritizes <strong>WRACK</strong> over <strong>EDUCE IRON</strong> for alchemists. <em>(11/16/2025 · post #163)</em></li>
<li>(311) You may now <strong>RELAX VENGEANCE</strong> (or <strong>SAVANT</strong>). <em>(12/9/2025 · post #165)</em></li>
<li>(56) <strong>POURING</strong> water on people specifically incurs some restrictions standard pour oes not. It requires you be able to act (on balance, not paralysed etc), and incurs a balance cost on its use. Alas, the days of escaping damnation by vigorously pouring water over yourself have come to an end. <em>(12/9/2025 · post #165)</em></li>
<li>(310) Things that stop <strong>SQUINT</strong> &lt;direction&gt; now also stop <strong>WHO</strong> &lt;direction&gt;. This most significantly applies to walls. <em>(12/9/2025 · post #165)</em></li>
<li>(176) Fixed an issue where balances going through a certain balance consuming method weren&#39;t showing up to the seebalances config. Most significantly applies to room hinders, but some abilities as well (like alchemist wrack). <em>(12/9/2025 · post #165)</em></li>
<li>(203) You now require at least one unbroken arm to have denizens give you items via the <strong>ORDER</strong> command. <em>(12/9/2025 · post #165)</em></li>
<li>The duration of the debuffs given by <strong>CLEANSEAURA</strong>, <strong>SOULSTORM</strong>, and <strong>PENITENCE</strong> against denizens has been doubled. <em>(12/16/2025 · post #166)</em></li>
<li><strong>MALIGNITY MAUL</strong>, <strong>DOMINION MAUL</strong>, <strong>DISCIPLINE RAKE</strong>, and <strong>VALOUR RAKE</strong> no longer use balance or equilibrium when cast. The damage of these skills has been slightly lowered to compensate. <em>(12/16/2025 · post #166)</em></li>
<li><strong>NOTE</strong>: All denizen healing abilities are <strong>NOT</strong> percentile and instead restore a base amount plus a random flat bonus. This means that the visible percentage restored may vary drastically based on the maximum health of the denizen. <em>(12/16/2025 · post #166)</em></li>
<li>(194) The <strong>SPEED</strong> defence no longer clears on death. <em>(12/31/2025 · post #167)</em></li>
<li>(186): You may now <strong>RELAX MASS</strong>/<strong>DENSITY</strong> to strip your mass defence. This is instant if not under aggression and has a three second delay if it is under aggression. This also both requires balance/equilibrium and incurs a three second equilibrium cost in both the aggressive and non-aggressive cases. <em>(1/31/2026 · post #168)</em></li>
<li>(admin) The standard clumsy rate has been reduced from 33% to 25% across the board. I&#39;m doing this now to give us some time before the championship events, if it proves to be unwise we&#39;ll move it back (but I suspect this will feel just generally better on all fronts). <em>(4/12/2026 · post #169)</em></li>
<li>(Admin): Fog now hides gmcp and names of people entering or leaving the room. <em>(6/5/2026 · post #170)</em></li>
<li>(Admin): Fog now blocks who here. <em>(6/5/2026 · post #170)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>Note: these two are to try to mitigate the perfect trackable information state of a given room.</li></ul></li>
<li>(309): Shrine consecrations are now disabled during active conquest/liberation battles (active meaning the windup period is concluded and a tank is present if applicable). You do not need to reconsecrate your shrines once the battle ends. <em>(8/4/2026 · post #171)</em></li>
<li>Commands that bypass stun now bypass stun in all cases (previously being stunned under aeon would lock some out). These lists have now been fully unified so should always match going forward. <em>(8/11/2026 · post #172)</em></li>
<li><strong>CRUSHED THROAT</strong> now functions as a silencing affliction in addition to its other features. <em>(8/11/2026 · post #172)</em></li>
<li>(183): The stack level for Kkractlebrand is now revealed to gmcp etc. <em>(8/18/2026 · post #173)</em></li>
<li>(183): Serverside now sips for if brand is present, similar to latch. No way to set for the level to sip at currently, but it will now cure it. <em>(8/18/2026 · post #173)</em></li>
<li>(214): Various things that didn&#39;t pull comms from rift now do. Notably campfires and various artificing checks. <em>(9/8/2026 · post #175)</em></li>
<li>(237): General improvements made to how defences operate. Enchantments notably are handled much better now. <em>(9/8/2026 · post #175)</em></li>
<li>(bug): outfit switching no longer bypasses shackle delayed mass in regards to the shackle artefact. <em>(10/23/2026 · post #178)</em></li>

<li>(307): Level one grimoire and gem of reincarnation have had their cooldowns reduced to twelve hours from twenty four. <em>(10/23/2026 · post #178)</em></li>
<li>(232): Third party affliction cures now only show to those who have relevant skill access where appropriate. <em>(10/23/2026 · post #178)</em><ul className="classlead-details"><li>The full affliction list for this is: bloodfire, coldfate, conflagration, constricted, degenerate, earworm, enmeshed, guilt, hatred, horror, inquisition, kkractlebrand, latched, lovers, mindravaged, mycalium, petrified, rebbies, reeling, retribution, shadowmadness, snared, tension, unweavings(all), and whisperingmadness.</li></ul></li>
